## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Compatibility and data

Describe incompatible changes, database migrations, new environment variables,
and any authentication or authorization impact. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `mix precommit`.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Added user-facing changes to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`, or explained why unnecessary.
- [ ] Added new environment variables to `mise.local.toml.example`, where applicable.
- [ ] Documented incompatible changes and migration steps, where applicable.
- [ ] Updated the version and changelog if this PR prepares a release.

Include relevant commands and results. Dependency auditing also runs in CI.

## Related issues

Link related issues, where applicable.
